name: Alfredo & Andrea
bio: Multiple-time world salsa and bachata champions celebrated for explosive acrobatics, high-speed spin combinations, and unmatched stage musicality across European congresses.

name: Masa & Polina
bio: Founders of the Bachazouk curriculum, integrating Brazilian Zouk circular head rolls, counterbalances, and organic wave motion seamlessly into Bachata partnerwork with strict biomechanical safety.

name: Luis & Andrea
bio: One of the most requested couples in global Latin dance festivals, renowned for their silky chest connection, fluid musical phrasing, and emotional stage showcases.

name: Ronald & Alba
bio: World Bachata Masters champions revered worldwide for their high-speed turns, dynamic drops, synchronization, and pedagogical clarity in master workshops.

name: Nacho & Silvia
bio: Renowned Spanish artists known for intricate combination leading, smooth circular energy, and electrifying festival appearances across Europe and the Americas.

name: Kike & Nahir
bio: Powerhouse duo fusing Argentine tango intensity with Spanish sensual bachata body isolations, commanding festival main stages worldwide.

name: Dario & Sara
bio: Sensational European artists known for breathtaking social dance videos, precise leading technique, and uplifting educational workshops.

name: Albir Rojas
bio: One of the key figures who introduced Kizomba and Tarraxinha to the international Latin festival circuit, admired for his deep body grounding, musical expression, and infectious warmth.
